# Every block below MUST be rejected.

# no verb
E1: John not

# common noun without an id
E1: old man send book-1

# a flag before a tag (flags are always last)
E1: John send report-1 [PAST] [to: Mary]

# unknown flag
E1: John send report-1 [YESTERDAY]

# unclosed tag
E1: John send report-1 [to: Mary

# reference to an event that does not exist
E1: John say E2 [PAST]

# wh-variable outside a question line
E1: ?who leave [PAST]

# unresolved third-person pronoun
E1: He send report-1 [PAST]

# article left in the text
E1: John send the report-1 [PAST]

# auxiliary left in the text instead of a flag
E1: John did send report-1

# unasserted event that nobody refers to
E1: John leave [PAST]
E2*: Mary stay

# label defined twice
E1: John leave [PAST]
E1: Mary stay [PAST]

# nested clause instead of an event reference
E1: John say Mary leave

# negation in the wrong place
E1: John send not report-1

# two verbs on one line
E1: John want leave [to: Paris] go

# malformed formula
E1: $x + * 2 = 3$

# event refers to itself
E1: John say E1

# sentence punctuation is not part of the language
E1: John leave.

# filler word left in the text
E1: server-1 be actually down

# events not numbered E1, E2, ... in line order
E2: John leave [PAST]
E1: Mary stay [PAST]

# noun ids do not start at 1
E1: John send report-3 [PAST]

# noun ids skip a number
E1: John send report-1 [to: Mary] [PAST]
E2: John send report-3 [to: Peter] [PAST]

# flags in the wrong order
E1: Mary leave [PERF] [PAST]
